return: String preserving every consonant at its original index while sorting the vowel characters into their original vowel slots in nondecreasing ASCII order.
mutation_aliasing: Inputs and caller-held aliases remain unchanged; working state is private. The Solution instance retains no state.
numeric: ASCII ordering places uppercase vowels before lowercase vowels identically in both languages. Indices/counts are bounded by string length; no Unicode normalization is implied. All integer inputs/intermediates remain within [-9007199254740991,9007199254740991]; no bitwise coercion is used.
complexity: O(n+v log(v+1)+1) time and O(n+v+1) auxiliary/output space for n characters and v vowels, including filter temporaries, copied characters and join. Bounds include ordinary built-in operations/allocations and assume bounded-word arithmetic, constant-time indexing, amortized append/pop and any explicitly stated hash/sort behavior.
